description: This file implements the shared channel service in Mattermost, handling cluster communication, synchronization, cache invalidation, and notifications related to shared channels across remote clusters.

classes.name: ServerIface
classes.description: Interface for server-related functionalities such as configuration, leadership status, cluster listeners, store access, logging, and remote cluster service.

classes.name: PlatformIface
classes.description: Interface for cache invalidation related to users and channels.

classes.name: AppIface
classes.description: Interface for application actions like creating posts, channels, managing reactions, notifications, and WebSocket publishing.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Main struct implementing shared channel synchronization, cluster communication, and related operations.

methods.name: NewSharedChannelService
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the shared channel service, initializing URLs and internal state.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the service, registering cluster listeners and initializing synchronization loops.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the service, removing listeners and stopping synchronization.

methods.name: Active
methods.description: Returns whether the service is currently active.

methods.name: sendEphemeralPost
methods.description: Sends an ephemeral post message to a user in a channel.

methods.name: onClusterLeaderChange
methods.description: Handles changes in cluster leadership status, resuming or pausing the service accordingly.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Activates the service, starting synchronization routines.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Deactivates the service, stopping synchronization routines.

methods.name: GetMemberSyncBatchSize
methods.description: Returns the configured batch size for member synchronization.

methods.name: makeChannelReadOnly
methods.description: Sets a channel to read-only mode, restricting post and reaction creation.

methods.name: onConnectionStateChange
methods.description: Handles remote cluster connection status changes, triggering syncs when a cluster comes online.

methods.name: notifyClientsForSharedChannelConverted
methods.description: Invalidates cache and notifies clients about a shared channel conversion.

methods.name: notifyClientsForSharedChannelUpdate
methods.description: Notifies clients about updates to a shared channel.

methods.name: postUnshareNotification
methods.description: Posts a system message indicating a channel is no longer shared.

methods.name: IsRemoteClusterDirectlyConnected
methods.description: Checks if a remote cluster has a direct connection to the current server.

methods.name: isGlobalUserSyncEnabled
methods.description: Determines if global user synchronization is enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: scheduleGlobalUserSync
methods.description: Schedules a task to synchronize all users with a remote cluster.

methods.name: HasPendingTasksForTesting
methods.description: Checks if there are pending synchronization tasks.

methods.name: HandleSyncAllUsersForTesting
methods.description: Exposes syncAllUsers method for testing purposes.

methods.name: OnReceiveSyncMessageForTesting
methods.description: Exposes onReceiveSyncMessage method for testing purposes.

methods.name: HandleChannelNotSharedErrorForTesting
methods.description: Exposes handleChannelNotSharedError method for testing.

methods.name: TransformMentionsOnReceiveForTesting
methods.description: Allows testing of mention transformation flow.
